note: Written by hand rather than by scripts/uc_source.py. The harvester's reference regex (REF in uc_source.py) lets its author group span newlines, so on a page that already carries prose bullets it fuses a bullet with the reference beneath it and derives a citekey from the prose. Running it on this page produced the citekey 'thepapersownresultsareequivalences...2007'. The fields below were filled from the fetched files: sha256_16 and pdf_pages computed, revision stamps read from eprint.iacr.org/archive/versions where the posting is on ePrint.

citations.note: Checked directly rather than trusted: 'pdftotext -layout' over the whole posting has one hit for 'functionalit', and it is the phrase 'may be omitted without altering functionality'. 'Universal' in the title means a ring signature verifiable under arbitrary key formats, not universal composability. This citation is the origin of a construction, not of a definition.
